VERDICT: ACCEPT
Pass 1 independently reviewed candidate df60d140135beb31867087435c1015343529a089 with HEAD confirmed and the full base-to-candidate diff inspected; AC-3 SATISFIED: max-minus-min and singleton behavior at src/math.mjs:72-73, exercised at test/math.test.mjs:85-90; R-1 SATISFIED in implementation: array, empty-array, and finite-number validation with required exception types at src/math.mjs:69-71, representative tests at test/math.test.mjs:91-95; R-2 SATISFIED: copying before sorting at src/math.mjs:72 and mutation assertion at test/math.test.mjs:96-100; R-3 SATISFIED: diff preserves existing functions at src/math.mjs:1-66 and existing tests at test/math.test.mjs:5-83, changing only the permitted existing import at test/math.test.mjs:3; R-4 SATISFIED: full diff changes only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs with no dependency or generated-file changes; R-5 SATISFIED: all four added test names at test/math.test.mjs:85,88,91,96 start with range.
Finding LOW at test/math.test.mjs:94: invalid-element coverage exercises a string but omits non-finite numeric inputs, allowing removal of the Number.isFinite check at src/math.mjs:71 to escape the range tests; smallest verification is to add range-prefixed assertions that NaN and Infinity inputs throw TypeError and rerun the range check, with severity LOW under the brief's explicit partial-subcase coverage rule.
Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^range" test/ exited 0 with result lines "tests 4", "pass 4", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with result lines "tests 19", "pass 18", "fail 1" and sole failure "clamp respects upper bound" at test/math.test.mjs:13, which is unchanged and explicitly expected; remaining uncertainty is limited to unexercised validation subcases, no checks were unavailable, no files were modified, and acceptance remains the coordinator's decision.
